The input is not encoded on output. This can happen on the server, when the template prints the text without escaping, or in the browser, when JavaScript inserts it as HTML (for example with innerHTML) instead of as text: in both cases any tags inside it become code.
Si distinguono per dove viene conservato: They differ in where the payload is stored and in who inserts it into the page:
<strong>Memorizzato (stored):</strong> i: Stored: the payload is saved on the server (a comment) and hits anyone who opens the page.
<strong>Riflesso (reflected):</strong> i: Reflected: the server echoes the payload back in the response to whoever follows a crafted link, once.
<strong>Basato sul DOM:</strong> il payl: DOM-based: the payload never reaches the server; the page's own JavaScript inserts input (for example from the URL) into the DOM.
Il codice gira nel browser della vittima: The code runs in the victim's browser: session cookie theft, actions on the victim's behalf, redirects, fake login forms.
Codifica in output (trattare <code>&lt;<: Output encoding (treating < as text), textContent instead of innerHTML.
Content-Security-Policy per limitare l'e: A Content-Security-Policy to restrict the execution of unauthorised scripts.
Cookie di sessione con flag HttpOnly e S: Session cookies with the HttpOnly and SameSite flags.
La wordlist sotto è solo didattica. La s: The wordlist below is for teaching only. The simulation shows attempts and fictitious HTTP responses; it sends no requests to real login pages.
Invia in automatico richieste di login u: Automatically sends login requests using lists of common passwords: collected from past breaches (such as RockYou) and predictable variants (company name + year, season + exclamation mark).
Password scelte da persone, quindi preve: Passwords chosen by people, and therefore predictable, and no limit on attempts: the cost to the attacker becomes low.
Una risposta diversa dalle altre (200 in: A response that differs from the others (200 instead of 401), a session cookie, a redirect to the dashboard: the simulator describes them in the log.
Rate limiting per IP e per account; CAPT: Rate limiting per IP and per account; progressive CAPTCHA.
Secondo fattore (TOTP, WebAuthn): la sol: A second factor (TOTP, WebAuthn): a guessed password alone is no longer enough.
Allarmi sui picchi di accessi falliti; r: Alerts on spikes of failed logins; rejecting passwords that appear in lists of compromised credentials (for example Have I Been Pwned).
Esempio didattico: file <code>foto.jpg</: Teaching example: a file called foto.jpg that actually contains server-side code. No file is written to disk.
